scripts.build: if [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] helpdesk frontend rebuild disabled on production servers (vite OOM-kills 4 GB tenants). Set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to override, or build via GitHub Actions.'; else yarn build:force; fi
scripts.enable-workspaces: sed -i '' 's/"aworkspaces"/"workspaces"/g' package.json && rm -rf node_modules ./desk/node_modules/ frappe-ui/node_modules/ && yarn install
